audit_scope: R5 frozen preregistration and result summary

explicit_source_blockers.bounded_R5_discovery: R5 preregistration caps exact discovery at 14 variables and forbids promotion from discovery to routing authority.
explicit_source_blockers.binary_exact_search: R3 exact_search_witness recursively branches over False/True assignments and therefore has no established polynomial bound.
explicit_source_blockers.separator_assignment_enumeration: R5 exact split iterates product((False, True), repeat=len(separator)), explicitly enumerating all separator assignments.
explicit_source_blockers.exact_fallback: R5 retains PROOF_CARRYING_EXACT_FALLBACK and uses exact DPLL/exact-search paths.
explicit_source_blockers.direct_challenge_flags: The earlier direct challenge already marks the global polynomial bounds and correctness-every-input obligations as unproved.

highest_admissible_claim: The current TRUMP lineage contains useful exact, proof-carrying and structural-search mechanisms, but it does not establish a polynomial-time algorithm for arbitrary CNF SAT. Explicit exhaustive/exact fallbacks remain in the execution path, multiple global polynomial bounds are unproved, R5 is bounded discovery-only, and R5 found zero positive-ROI spiral cases. P vs NP therefore remains OPEN.
next_closure_target: Replace or globally bound every exhaustive primitive and fallback, then prove end-to-end polynomial time and total correctness for arbitrary CNF without finite caps. Only after every closure obligation is machine-checkably discharged may a P=NP claim enter closure review.
